title: State v. Andrews (N.J. 2020)
key_points: Holding: A court may compel a defendant to disclose phone passcodes when a warrant authorizes the search and the State shows it already knows the passcodes exist, the defendant possesses them and they are authentic (foregone conclusion).
officer_notes: Scenario: With a warrant for two phones, the prosecutor seeks an order requiring the defendant to unlock them.
Takeaway: Work with the prosecutor; this is a court process, not a roadside demand.
